Our inside–out definition of the maximal multistep map for weakly orthogonal TRSs straightforwardly extends to all weakly orthogonal higher-order term rewrite systems, and the Z-property still holds (in [29] we established the angle property), which immediately yields the same for the λβη-calculus.
